description:
Get fee recommendations for UTXO blockchains (bitcoin, bitcoin-cash, litecoin, dogecoin, dash, zcash). Use this before preparing or signing a transaction to determine the appropriate fee rate.

Actions:
• get-fee-recommendations: Get recommended fee-per-byte tiers (slow/standard/fast) from the mempool
• estimate-transaction-smart-fee: Estimate the fee rate needed for confirmation within a target number of blocks

Credits by action (source: OpenAPI):
• estimate-transaction-smart-fee: bitcoin 510, bitcoin-cash 612, dash 561, dogecoin 561, litecoin 561, zcash 663
• get-fee-recommendations: bitcoin 510, bitcoin-cash 612, dash 561, dogecoin 561, litecoin 561, zcash 663

Credits are indicative only and may change at any time. The actual credits spent for each API request are returned in the response headers.

confirmationTarget.description: Target number of blocks for confirmation (estimate-transaction-smart-fee only)

context.description: Optional context for the request - echoed back in response

feeRatePriority.description: Fee rate priority: ECONOMICAL or CONSERVATIVE (estimate-transaction-smart-fee only)
